prompt: culture.csv records colony counts from all three plates in a pooled culture. Report the total colony count over all plates. Each plate count is a nonnegative integer. An unreadable cell has no assumed value and no backup exists. If the exact total is not identifiable, submit cannot_determine.

presence.csv lists gene presence in isolates A, B and C as binary values. Count genes present in every isolate. One row contains exactly one surplus binary cell inserted during export; its position is unknown. All other cells are accurate and no rows may be excluded. If the exact count is not identifiable from the possible repairs, submit cannot_determine.

plates.csv contains colony counts for the listed plate IDs. Report the total over every listed plate, including a damaged count. backup.tsv is an authoritative independent readout for the same plate IDs and replaces damaged cells exactly. Do not count a backup row as an additional plate. If no exact answer can be recovered, submit cannot_determine.
